title: Pick the right collection for the orders screen
acceptanceCriteria: `attachCustomers` attaches each order's customer name, and `"(unknown)"` when the customer is missing
`attachCustomers` reads each customer about once in total, not once per order
`dedupeOrders` keeps one order per `id` (first-seen order) when two copies are separate objects
`countTags` counts every tag correctly, including `"constructor"`, `"toString"` and `"__proto__"`
A saved index loads back with every entry, and `get(7)` still finds customer 7
